name: project-architecture
description: Maps and evolves RamiroX Market incrementally without unnecessary rewrites.

# Project Architecture Skill
1. Read AGENTS.md, package scripts, build scripts, app entry points and deployment config.
2. Map catalog, product rendering, cart, checkout, Supabase calls, WhatsApp handoff and admin surfaces.
3. Identify source-of-truth boundaries for products, prices, stock, delivery and commissions.
4. Document dependencies, data flow, failure modes and constraints.
5. Prefer focused changes compatible with existing static HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
6. Add dependencies or propose framework migration only with a written benefit/risk analysis.
7. Update architecture notes when verified behavior changes.
